items.title: Kia India opens pre-bookings for hybrid Sorento ahead of India launch
items.summary: The all-new Sorento will become Kia India's first hybrid SUV, with the automaker teasing its flagship global model ahead of its official debut.

items.title: MG Select launches couture editions of M9, Cyberster in collaboration with designer Gaurav Gupta
items.summary: Both vehicles feature hand-finished detailing, tonal layering and embroidery inspired by Gupta's Serpent Infinity design language, which the designer associates with continuity, transformation and quiet power.

items.title: BMW India opens pre-launch bookings for 7 Series range
items.summary: Customers can choose between internal combustion engine and all-electric variants ahead of the luxury sedan's launch.

items.title: Nissan India July wholesales more than triple as Tekton rolls out
items.summary: Export wholesales stood at 4,821 units, taking total wholesales to 9,339 units in July
